title: Quant intake pipeline, canary orchestration, and model-version pin management for mixed-precision variants
creator: Ravi Patel
description:
Objective: Build an automated intake pipeline that accepts quantized candidate artifacts (INT8, FP8, GPTQ, AWQ), runs a reproducible micro-benchmark and eval suite, publishes a performance/quality artifact, and wires an SLO-aware canary orchestration that performs staged rollouts with automatic rollback and model-version pin management.

Why: Teams keep onboarding mixed-precision variants manually. This causes inconsistent telemetry, missed regressions, and risky rollouts. We need a repeatable flow so product teams can pin safe variants and the runtime can fallback transparently when regressions appear.

Scope:
- Author an intake service that validates quant artifact metadata (model hash, quant method, bitwidth, kernel hints) and stores canonical artifacts.
- Add CI steps to run a standard micro-benchmark: latency P50/P95, throughput (tokens/s), memory footprint, and a small suite of MLQA/regression prompts to measure quality delta vs baseline.
- Produce a published artifact (quant-metadata.json) with canonical metrics and an integrity signature consumed by the serving runtime and console.
- Implement canary orchestration: staged canary phases (shadow -> 1% -> 10% -> 50%) with automatic gating based on pre-defined thresholds for latency increase, throughput loss, and quality delta.
- Add model-version pin management to console and control plane APIs to allow product teams to pin a variant per-route or per-customer.
- Instrument regression alerts and automated rollback: if canary metrics breach thresholds or post-rollout metric drift is detected, trigger automatic rollback and create a ticket with attached artifacts.

Acceptance criteria:
- Intake pipeline accepts example INT8 and GPTQ artifacts end-to-end and emits quant-metadata.json with >= 95% reproducible micro-benchmark numbers across three runs.
- Canary phases complete automatically and stop/rollback if: latency P95 increases > 25ms over baseline, throughput drops > 15%, or quality regression > 2% absolute (or relative detection per model family).
- Console displays pin status and history; API allows pin/unpin and lists active pins per-route.
- At least two internal teams have used the pipeline to onboard variants and completed a canary rollout without manual intervention.

Implementation notes and trade-offs:
- We will use the existing benchmarking harness in infra/benchmarks but add additional kernels to exercise KV cache patterns and short-sequence throughput.
- For quality eval we use a small focused prompt set (200 examples) per model family to keep runtime quick; follow-ups will add larger offline suites.
- Canary thresholds are conservative initially and configurable per-model via quant-metadata.json. More aggressive thresholds can be enabled by SRE/product after initial runs.
- Storage: artifacts are immutable and signed; we recommend using object storage with lifecycle rules to keep recent variants.

Rollout plan:
1) Prototype intake + CI harness for two model families (decoder-only LLM and encoder-decoder) — 2 sprints.
2) Integrate canary controller with routing service and add rollback hooks — 1 sprint.
3) Console pin UI + API + docs — 1 sprint.
4) Internal onboarding with 2 pilot teams and iterate thresholds — 3 weeks.

Monitoring and metrics to ship:
- Canary metric set: baseline_latency_p50, baseline_latency_p95, canary_latency_p50, canary_latency_p95, baseline_throughput_tps, canary_throughput_tps, quality_accuracy_baseline, quality_accuracy_canary, signoff_passed (boolean).
- Telemetry events: quant.intake.submitted, quant.intake.completed, quant.canary.phase.transition, quant.canary.rollback, quant.pin.created, quant.pin.removed.
- Dashboards: per-model family canary trends, pin inventory, and recent rollbacks (with links to quant-metadata.json).

Follow-ups:
- Expand quality suite to 2k examples, add statistical significance testing for regression alerts.
- Add GPU kernel selection hints into quant-metadata to guide serving runtime for best perf.
- Support auto-recommendation of fallback variants when a pin expires or is rolled back.
